// One item per PromQL query; "Thanos" runs each, "Build digest" reads them back by key.
const queries = {
  // Health
  firing: 'ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}',
  volsync_total: 'count(max by (obj_namespace, obj_name)(volsync_volume_out_of_sync{role="source"}))',
  volsync_oos: 'max by (obj_namespace, obj_name)(volsync_volume_out_of_sync{role="source"}) == 1',
  volsync_stale: 'changes(max by (obj_namespace, obj_name)(volsync_sync_duration_seconds_count{role="source"})[26h:5m]) == 0',
  cnpg_age: 'time() - max by (cnpg_cluster)(barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp > 0)',
  longhorn_backup_age: 'max by (pvc_namespace, pvc)(time() - (longhorn_volume_last_backup_at > 0))',
  etcd_s3_age: 'time() - max(k3s_etcd_snapshot_creation_timestamp{bucket!=""})',
  cronjob_age: 'time() - max by (namespace, cronjob)(kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace=~"uptime-kuma|longhorn-system|backup-verify|technitium"})',
  thanos_halted: 'max(thanos_compact_halted)',
  loki_compact_age: 'time() - max(loki_boltdb_shipper_compact_tables_operation_last_successful_run_timestamp_seconds{job="monitoring/loki"})',
  // Action items
  longhorn_alloc: 'bottomk(3, max by (node)(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes))',
  pvc_full: 'max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left() max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{storageclass=~"longhorn.*"}) > 0.8',
  cert_expiry: 'min by (namespace, name)(certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds - time())',
  restarts: 'topk(5, max by (namespace, pod, container)(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[7d])) > 3)',
  // Trends (this week vs last)
  speed_down: 'quantile_over_time(0.5, max(speedtest_tracker_download_bits)[7d:1h])',
  speed_down_prev: 'quantile_over_time(0.5, max(speedtest_tracker_download_bits)[7d:1h] offset 7d)',
  speed_up: 'quantile_over_time(0.5, max(speedtest_tracker_upload_bits)[7d:1h])',
  speed_up_prev: 'quantile_over_time(0.5, max(speedtest_tracker_upload_bits)[7d:1h] offset 7d)',
  speed_ping: 'quantile_over_time(0.5, max(speedtest_tracker_ping_ms)[7d:1h])',
  speed_ping_prev: 'quantile_over_time(0.5, max(speedtest_tracker_ping_ms)[7d:1h] offset 7d)',
  longhorn_used: 'sum(max by (node)(longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes))',
  longhorn_used_prev: 'sum(max by (node)(longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes offset 7d))',
  crowdsec_decisions: 'sum by (origin)(cs_active_decisions)',
  crowdsec_decisions_prev: 'sum by (origin)(cs_active_decisions offset 7d)',
  crowdsec_blocks: 'sum(increase(cs_appsec_block_total[7d]))',
};

return Object.entries(queries).map(([key, query]) => ({ json: { key, query } }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', max_tokens: 2000, output_config: { effort: 'low' }, system: "You write the opening line of a weekly homelab health digest posted to Discord. Given the digest, reply with 2-3 short sentences on what stands out this week: anything red or needing action first, then any notable trend. Only use facts and numbers present in the digest; never invent or estimate. If everything is green and flat, say so in one sentence. Plain text, no headings.", messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.tldrInput }] }) }}
